ETH.note: The Artificial Intelligence Institution's mandate is stated as research, data processing and infrastructure, not control of AI harms.
A budget line only; no government use of an AI system is stated.
No sectoral AI tool is stated.

facts.fact: Ethiopia's 2026/27 federal budget proclamation, per the Ministry of Finance workbook, appropriates ETB 162,080,000 from the Treasury to the Artificial Intelligence Institution for National Artificial Intelligence Datacenter Deployment and ETB 170,000,000 for a National Artificial Intelligence Research Laboratory.
